text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—My precious three years with Loves Only You
have finally come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, they were tumultuous days...
that seemed to test her love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And right now, at the Breeders' Cup,
the festival of Umamusume held in America."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her finely trained love was about to shake history to its core—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――Loves Only You is fifth
just in behind the leaders!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Go-o-o!!" "You can do it, Loves-chan!"
"Great position!!" "From here on out!!"
"We're all watching!!" "Deliver our love!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(It's okay. I can feel it. We're connected.
Across the sea, with everyone—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Right here, right now, with you, my dearest!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Right here, right now, with you, my most beloved!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You is coming!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Loves Only You
to win it for Japan!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...At the Breeders' Cup she finally reached,
she became the first Japanese Umamusume in history to seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The spectacle of that moment, the glory. It truly was... a world that only she had witnessed.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, could you share a few words
with your fans back in Japan?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You with Trainer ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...The challenge we two took on was made possible only thanks to the support of the community I manage."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I dedicate today's victory
to my dearest community members!
Thank you all so very much♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This interview with Loves Only You,
along with her monumental feat, spread among race fans in an instant—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You's community received worldwide acclaim
as one of the best Umamusume fan communities—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You and I were celebrated for making history,
alongside a photo of us making a heart sign together...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few months later...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You's challenge against the world had reached a milestone,
bringing a period of calm like a peaceful sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You is on an extended break.
While I was pondering plans for her next challenge alone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was sure another warm, wonderful time
with my community members was about to begin.
Thinking that, I opened up the stream, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You came right away, didn't you, Mr. Bridge-builder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I opened the stream, I noticed something strange.
There were no comments at all.
In fact, I was the only viewer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry for startling you.
I had the members of my circle help me out."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to convey this to Bridge-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Miss Bridge-builder.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As a commu-member, as my Trainer,
and as a bridge connecting me to everyone and the world,
you've given me so much, so much love...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Bridge-san, I've been able to share even more love with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Delivering a historic first victory to everyone...
I was able to prove to the world
just how precious our bond is...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Truly...
no amount of gratitude could ever be enough...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That was my line to say.
What Loves Only You gave to me was far too great to put into words—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...You know, though,
gratitude isn't what I truly want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's...
because I want to tell you in person. So—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's something...
I want to tell you in person. So—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting right here, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting right here, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You's stream ended there.
Right after, notifications started pouring in from where she chats with her community members.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
" 'Go, bridge builder!' 'Loves-chan is waiting!'
'Run!' 'Don't keep her waiting too long!'
'Have a safe trip!' 'GO GO GO GO!!' "

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"‘We're counting on you, our bridge.
Stay by her side for us, too.’"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: "All of us want her to be by your side, too. That's how we feel."

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"‘So, please go.
For her sake. For your sake.
For all of our sakes.’"

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text: "Promise me. Absolutely――――――――――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before I knew it, I was running.
Desperately heading toward the place entrusted to me by my circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With nothing in my heart――
except the single wish to meet Loves Only You.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for coming,
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for coming,
Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What I truly want to tell you...
————will you listen to it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...To me, "love" means connection.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Caring for each other, understanding each other, sharing with each other, supporting each other, helping each other...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because such a connection could be made with anyone,
"love" is exceedingly commonplace—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why it is so precious,
and I still believe that even now."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I still believe that true love is found in those bonds—where we care for one another, share with one another, support one another, and help one another.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“Still... but you see...—
Before I knew it, I realized.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The one who understands the sanctity of connection, of love,
and who loves it alongside me...
There is only one—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...That there's only Trainer-kun for me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That there's no one else but Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...To me, you are the only one in the entire world
who is truly special.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...To me, you are
the only one in the world who is special.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So......... from now on, forever and always.........
As your trainee Uma Musume...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So......... from now on, forever and always.........
As your trainee Uma Musume...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Is Loves Only You okay with you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I reach my hand out to Loves Only You,
as if shaping one half of a heart."
choice_data_list: You'll always be Loves Only You to me.
You'll always be Loves Only You, through and through.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Loves Only You, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Two shadows overlap, forming a single silhouette.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was bathed for a long, long time in the setting sun—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...It feels like it's just the two of us in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was the one and only love
that only I had ever witnessed in the whole wide world.
